developments.title: OCTO open-source robot foundation model
developments.summary: OCTO is a transformer‑based generalist robot policy pretrained on 800 k trajectories from the Open X‑Embodiment dataset, released as open‑source software.

claims.text: Open-source generalist models such as OCTO emphasize shared research infrastructure and broader robot-data coverage.
claims.evidence: Open-source generalist models such as OCTO emphasize shared research infrastructure and broader robot-data coverage.

claims.text: Octo is a large, transformer‑based policy pretrained on 800k demonstrations from the Open X‑Embodiment dataset.

developments.title: ACT (Action Chunk Transformer) open-source robot foundation model
developments.summary: ACT is a transformer-based action chunking model for robotic manipulation, enabling high success rates with limited demonstrations.

claims.text: ACT leverages transformer-based action chunking and end-to-end imitation learning to enable low-cost robotic arms to perform complex tasks with high success rates.
claims.evidence: ACT leverages transformer-based action chunking and end-to-end imitation learning to enable low-cost robotic arms to perform complex tasks with high success rates.
